our angel is not only with us; he also sees god the father. he is in a relationship with him. he is the daily bridge; from the moment we arise to the moment we go to bed. he accompanies us and is a link between us and god the father. the angel is the daily gateway to transcendence, to the encounter with the father: that is, the angel helps me to go forward because he looks upon the father, and he knows the way. let us not forget these companions along the journey. pope francis october 2018 angel of god, my guardian dear, to whom god’s love commits me here, ever this day be at my side to light and guard, to rule and guide. amen

tempo: friday 7.00pm adoration of the blessed sacrament: takes place in the church of the immaculate conception, tempo each friday morning from 10am – 1pm. parishioners are welcome to come along. confessions: in st michael’s chur ch, enniskillen each saturday 10am – 12 noon and 5pm – 5.45pm anniversaries: tempo: sunday 25/10 (11.00am) very rev. fr john halton, friday 30/10 (7.00pm) paddy mccusker, shillanmore. cradien : sunday 25/10 (9.30am ) michael (mac) mcgirr, breagho. we celebrate the month’s memory mass for the late very rev. fr. john halton, today at 11.00am. tea and refreshments will be available in st. mary’s community centre after the mass. reflection: what is our life for? much of life today is spent managing responsibilities, meeting demands, going to appointments, and trying to find a little time for ourselves. amid all this activity, we can gradually become less available to one another, often without noticing. today's gospel invites us to reconsider what our lives are for. jesus places love of god and love of neighbour at the heart of everything. our lives are not simply our own to manage. they are gifts received from god. and the same is true of everybody else. each person matters to god, independently of what they may mean to us. christian faith invites us to grow in our awareness of these relationships and to become more capable of living them. we do not become fully ourselves on our own. our journey towards maturity, and ultimately towards heaven, is a journey into deeper communion with god and with one another. that is the life for which we have been created. church of the immaculate conception 200th anniversary: we will mark this significant milestone with a celebration mass on sunday 6th december at 11.00am. we would appreciate if you had any old photos, memories or recollections to share. photographs can be scanned and returned to the owner or copies can be forwarded to
tempo@clogherparishes.ie
